budget_items.topic: Per-property tax amount in override comment
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident said that if all property owners paid a stated amount in the next fiscal year, overrides would not need discussing.
budget_items.quote: if all property owners pay $1,386.33 in the next fiscal year we will no longer need to discuss overrides.

budget_items.topic: FY2025/FY2026 revenue budget and new growth
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager described the revenue budget's estimate of new revenues and their split between Town and school.
budget_items.quote: the revenue budget suggested there was $1.2m in new revenues with $520k going to the town and $680k going to the school.

budget_items.topic: Health insurance and retirement cost increases
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager described a 16% increase in health insurance and a Worcester County Retirement figure as expenditure pressures.
budget_items.quote: on the expenditure side we are looking at a 16% increase in health insurance for $489k and $264k from worcester county retirement.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $1.2M Capital Plan was put together by the Town's finance staff and largely shared with the Capital Planning Committee.
budget_items.quote: mr. terenzini had put together a $1.2m capital plan, much of which was shared with the capital planning committee.

budget_items.topic: Debt service reduction used to offset capital plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager said $225k from the reduction in debt service is planned to offset the capital plan, and she is unsure it can be accomplished.
budget_items.quote: there is $225k from the reduction in debt service used to offset the capital plan

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Some Free Cash transfers that had been planned were discussed; no amounts are printed and no transfer was voted.
budget_items.quote: she also discussed some free cash transfers that had been planned.

budget_items.topic: Miscellaneous non-recurring revenue drop and audit
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Budget Task Force noted miscellaneous non-recurring revenue dropped from about $1M by $400,000 and stayed down, prompting a proposed audit.
budget_items.quote: the amount dropped from about $1m by $400,000 and stayed down.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A forensic audit was suggested, but the minutes say such audits can be expensive; no amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: a forensic audit had been suggested, but they can be expensive.
